title.en: Human development and an appraisal of strategies
title.kn: ಮಾನವ ಅಭಿವೃದ್ಧಿ ಮತ್ತು ಅಭಿವೃದ್ಧಿ ತಂತ್ರಗಳ ಮೌಲ್ಯಮಾಪನ

hook.en: A country can grow fast and still leave people sick, unschooled or voiceless. How do India, China and Pakistan compare on the lives of their people?
hook.kn: ಒಂದು ದೇಶ ವೇಗವಾಗಿ ಬೆಳೆದರೂ ಜನರು ರೋಗಿಗಳಾಗಿ, ಅಶಿಕ್ಷಿತರಾಗಿ ಉಳಿಯಬಹುದು. ಜನರ ಬದುಕಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಭಾರತ, ಚೀನಾ, ಪಾಕಿಸ್ತಾನ ಹೇಗೆ ಹೋಲುತ್ತವೆ?

objectives.en: Compare human development indicators of the three countries
Appraise the development strategies of China, Pakistan and India

narration.en: A country can grow fast and still leave people sick, unschooled or voiceless. How do India, China and Pakistan compare on the lives of their people?
narration.kn: ಒಂದು ದೇಶ ವೇಗವಾಗಿ ಬೆಳೆದರೂ ಜನರು ರೋಗಿಗಳಾಗಿ, ಅಶಿಕ್ಷಿತರಾಗಿ ಉಳಿಯಬಹುದು. ಜನರ ಬದುಕಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಭಾರತ, ಚೀನಾ, ಪಾಕಿಸ್ತಾನ ಹೇಗೆ ಹೋಲುತ್ತವೆ?

body.en: China is ahead of India and Pakistan on most human development indicators: the Human Development Index value, life expectancy, literacy, and lower infant and maternal mortality. Pakistan is ahead of India in reducing the proportion of people below the poverty line. But these indicators are not enough. NCERT suggests also using liberty indicators, which measure the extent of democratic participation in social and political decision-making, such as constitutional protection of the rights of citizens and the independence of the judiciary and the rule of law.

points.en: Pakistan ahead of India in reducing poverty
Liberty indicators: democratic participation and rights

narration.en: China leads India and Pakistan on most human development indicators, and Pakistan has done better than India in reducing poverty. We should also look at liberty indicators: how freely people take part in social and political decisions.
narration.kn: ಹೆಚ್ಚಿನ ಮಾನವ ಅಭಿವೃದ್ಧಿ ಸೂಚಕಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಚೀನಾ ಮುಂದಿದೆ; ಬಡತನ ಕಡಿತದಲ್ಲಿ ಪಾಕಿಸ್ತಾನ ಭಾರತಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಮುಂದಿದೆ. ಸ್ವಾತಂತ್ರ್ಯ ಸೂಚಕಗಳನ್ನೂ ನೋಡಬೇಕು.

title.en: On the board: Appraising the three paths

narration.en: Let us appraise the strategies of the three neighbours on the board.

say.en: Let us compare the three countries side by side.
China built health, education and land reforms first, then opened up with SEZs and FDI.
India kept democratic institutions and grew through services, but agriculture still holds many workers.
Pakistan faced political instability, depended on remittances and foreign aid, and had volatile farm output.
On human development, China leads, followed by India and then Pakistan.

body.en: China's reforms succeeded because it had already created a strong base before 1978: basic health services, education, land reforms, decentralised planning and small enterprises; the commune system had also ensured a more equitable distribution of food grains. Reforms then brought SEZs, foreign investment and fast growth of manufacturing. Pakistan's slow growth and the re-emergence of poverty are explained by political instability, over-dependence on remittances and foreign aid, and agricultural growth that depended on good harvests rather than on technical change. India, with democratic institutions, has grown mainly through services, but much of its workforce remains in agriculture and its infrastructure is weak.

points.en: China: strong pre-reform base in health, education, land reform
Pakistan: instability, remittances and aid, volatile farming
India: democracy, service-led growth, weak infrastructure

narration.en: China's reforms built on a strong base of health, education and land reform. Pakistan was held back by instability, dependence on remittances and aid, and unstable farming. India, a democracy, grew through services but still has many workers on farms.
narration.kn: ಚೀನಾದ ಸುಧಾರಣೆಗಳು ಆರೋಗ್ಯ, ಶಿಕ್ಷಣ, ಭೂ ಸುಧಾರಣೆಯ ಭದ್ರ ಬುನಾದಿಯ ಮೇಲೆ ನಿಂತವು. ಪಾಕಿಸ್ತಾನವನ್ನು ರಾಜಕೀಯ ಅಸ್ಥಿರತೆ ಮತ್ತು ವಿದೇಶಿ ನೆರವಿನ ಅವಲಂಬನೆ ಹಿಂದಕ್ಕೆಳೆದವು. ಭಾರತ ಸೇವಾ ವಲಯದಿಂದ ಬೆಳೆಯಿತು.

problem.en: Give two reasons why China grew faster after its 1978 reforms than Pakistan did after its 1988 reforms.

steps.en: China: reforms rested on a pre-reform base of health, education, land reforms and decentralised planning, so workers were ready for industry.
China: SEZs and foreign investment boosted manufacturing and exports.
Pakistan: political instability and dependence on remittances and foreign aid made growth unstable.
Pakistan: farm growth depended on good harvests, not on steady technical change.

answer.en: China had a strong human base and used SEZs and FDI; Pakistan suffered from instability, dependence on remittances and aid, and volatile agriculture.

points.kn: ಸ್ವಾತಂತ್ರ್ಯ ಸೂಚಕಗಳು ನಿರ್ಧಾರಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಜಾಸತ್ತಾತ್ಮಕ ಭಾಗವಹಿಸುವಿಕೆಯನ್ನು ಅಳೆಯುತ್ತವೆ.

points.en: China built a strong base before reforms; Pakistan suffered instability and dependence on aid; India grew through services.
points.kn: ಚೀನಾ ಸುಧಾರಣೆಗೆ ಮೊದಲು ಭದ್ರ ಬುನಾದಿ ಕಟ್ಟಿತು; ಪಾಕಿಸ್ತಾನ ಅಸ್ಥಿರತೆಯಿಂದ ನರಳಿತು; ಭಾರತ ಸೇವೆಗಳಿಂದ ಬೆಳೆಯಿತು.

homework.en: Compare and contrast the development of India, China and Pakistan in about 150 words.

narration.en: Recap. China leads India and Pakistan on most human development indicators. Liberty indicators measure democratic participation in decisions. China built a strong base before reforms; Pakistan suffered instability and dependence on aid; India grew through services.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಹೆಚ್ಚಿನ ಮಾನವ ಅಭಿವೃದ್ಧಿ ಸೂಚಕಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಚೀನಾ ಭಾರತ ಮತ್ತು ಪಾಕಿಸ್ತಾನಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಮುಂದಿದೆ. ಸ್ವಾತಂತ್ರ್ಯ ಸೂಚಕಗಳು ನಿರ್ಧಾರಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಜಾಸತ್ತಾತ್ಮಕ ಭಾಗವಹಿಸುವಿಕೆಯನ್ನು ಅಳೆಯುತ್ತವೆ. ಚೀನಾ ಸುಧಾರಣೆಗೆ ಮೊದಲು ಭದ್ರ ಬುನಾದಿ ಕಟ್ಟಿತು; ಪಾಕಿಸ್ತಾನ ಅಸ್ಥಿರತೆಯಿಂದ ನರಳಿತು; ಭಾರತ ಸೇವೆಗಳಿಂದ ಬೆಳೆಯಿತು.
